title: Proactive Recovery Flow Assets: visual tutorials & troubleshooting wizard for rate-limits/timeouts/retries
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of onboarding/quickstart visual assets and step-by-step troubleshooting graphics that teach users how to detect and recover from rate limits, timeouts, and retry loops. Assets should work inside the product Quickstart UI, in docs pages, and as standalone PNG/SVG assets for the knowledge base. The goal is to reduce first-week support tickets for common inference errors and to increase self-serve recovery success.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with separate frames for: inline compact card, full-page wizard, modal recovery overlay, and lightweight animated micro-interaction
Exported responsive assets: SVG icons, 2x/3x PNGs, and a Lottie JSON for the retry animation
Documentation screenshots (desktop + mobile) and an insertable markdown snippet for docs with copy and code example for SDK retry hints
Accessibility checks passed: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, ARIA labels for interactive elements, keyboard path for wizard
Product implementation ticket with annotated specs and asset export links + design handoff in Figma completed
decisions: Use a three-tier guidance: Detect -> Explain -> Recover (compact card -> expanded wizard -> proactive retry)
Primary CTA text set to 'Try again with backoff' and secondary to 'View diagnostics'
Illustration style: simplified system-objects (server, queue, clock) with brand accent color to indicate state changes
Show estimated retry wait time in seconds and optional auto-retry toggle in dedicated quickstart runs
progress_updates: 2025-11-10: Kickoff workshop with PM and eng to map error flows and instrumentation events
2025-11-11: First-pass wireframes for compact card + modal wizard; validated core content with Docs lead
2025-11-12: Hi-fi mockups completed; exported initial SVG icon set; started accessibility audit
review_feedback: PM (Gabe Ortiz): simplify copy for non-technical users and add a link to 'cost impact' callout
Engineering (Marcus Li): include the exact telemetry keys to surface in the UI and a fallback when telemetry is missing
Docs (Rina Shah): add a short code example for setting exponential backoff in SDK and an explicit 'What this means' line for each state
accessibility_notes: Color palette adjusted to meet contrast for informative/warning states; icons include descriptive alt text and the wizard exposes status via ARIA-live regions for screen readers. Keyboard focus order documented in Figma notes.
release_notes_snippet: Adds quickstart visual guide and troubleshooting wizard for rate-limits/timeouts with copy and assets for docs and Console. Provides an inline recovery CTA and exported assets for knowledge base.
notes_for_engineering: Telemetry events required: error.type, error.count_window, avg_latency_ms, last_retry_timestamp
Design provides 3 density variants: compact (list), medium (card), full (wizard). Please ensure CSS tokens for spacing map to design system values
If telemetry unavailable show generic 'Connection interrupted' copy and surface a link to manual diagnostics page
